== Summary ==
[[James Booker]] (centre, Team Ohio shirt, facing the camera) plays [[Scott Lingrell]] (left, back to camera) at the [[2008 Match Play Championship]], January 2008. Flickr caption by Nate Meeker: "Scott blowing Booker out".

== Source ==
Photo by [[Nate Meeker]], Flickr: [https://www.flickr.com/photos/53301220@N00/2173884409/ DSCN0077] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2142/2173884409_d20dc602f0_b.jpg). Album linked in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=254001#p254001 post by Meeker] (Nate Meeker), "Nate Meeker PICTURES!", Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, 7 January 2008, linking his Flickr album "MPC 2008 GG". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005855/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t18290.html Internet Archive]
